3D printing libraries search: Use Library Finder (https://librarytechnology.org/libraries/3D-printers) or contact your local library system.

Teen volunteer opportunities: Search VolunteerMatch (https://www.volunteermatch.org/search?l=&categories=6) or local parks department websites.

Project timeline templates: Microsoft Office (https://templates.office.com/en-us/timelines) or Smartsheet (https://www.smartsheet.com/content/project-timeline-templates).

Schengen visa processing: Typically 15 calendar days. Official info: https://schengenvisainfo.com/visa-processing-time/
Overnight shipping: FedEx Priority Overnight, UPS Next Day Air, or USPS Priority Mail Express. Compare at https://www.shippingschool.com/same-day-shipping/

Online piano teachers: Try Lessonface (https://www.lessonface.com/piano) or TakeLessons (https://takelessons.com/piano-lessons).

Hiking checklist: REI's beginner guide (https://www.rei.com/learn/expert-advice/day-hiking-checklist.html) covers essential gear.

Free senior tax filing: IRS Free File (https://www.irs.gov/filing/free-file-do-your-federal-taxes-for-free) for incomes under $73k, or AARP Foundation Tax-Aide.
